def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Order_ID'], keep='first')
    allowed_categories = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]
    allowed_regions = ["North", "South", "East", "West"]
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip()
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip()
    valid_rows = df[
        (df['Category'].isin(allowed_categories)) &
        (df['Region'].notna()) &
        (df['Region'].isin(allowed_regions))
    ]
    return valid_rows

def answer(df):
    return df.groupby('Region')['Revenue'].sum().to_dict()
